definition: VC Dimension is a measure of the capacity of a statistical classification model, defined as the size of the largest dataset that can be shattered by the classifier.
details: VC Dimension is a measure of the capacity of a statistical classification model, defined as the size of the largest dataset that can be shattered by the classifier. It helps in understanding the model's ability to generalize to unseen data.
